big_case.notes: Paid certiorari petition represented by the Institute for Free Speech with four ideological amicus briefs challenging Colorado state legislators' enforcement of committee-hearing decorum rules barring 'misgendering' and 'deadnaming' during public comment on HB 24-1071. While the petition touches a salient First Amendment viewpoint-discrimination flashpoint and frames a doctrinal tension between Supreme Court of Virginia v. Consumers Union (1980) and Kentucky v. Graham (1985), every circuit to address state legislators follows Consumers Union in extending legislative immunity to prospective equitable relief, the dispute is confined to internal state legislative committee procedures where non-legislator enforcement staff were not sued, and the Court denied certiorari cleanly on November 16, 2026 without CVSG, post-conference relist, or noted dissent.
